}}'''Jalindin''' is a [[Seekers for Truth|Seeker for Truth]] in [[Seanchan]].{{Ref|{{twotc}}, Jalindin}}

== Appearance ==
Jalindin has a severe face and dark eyes.

== History ==
Jalindin interrogated a son and daughter of Empress [[Radhanan]].

== Activities ==
Jalindin is with a group of soldiers in Seanchan, when they find the [[Gateway]] left by [[Rand al'Thor]] and [[Aviendha]]. She is held by bonds of Air by Aviendha. She puts the noblewoman [[Morsa]], and the ''[[sul'dam]]'' and ''[[damane]]'' with her, into the custody of the [[Seekers for Truth]] after Rand and Aviendha escape.{{ref/book|5|32}}
